# Go Mode Service Discovery API Reference

<!-- Code generated by gen-api-sdk; DO NOT EDIT. -->

Service-neutral JSON discovery manifest served publicly at `/.well-known/gomode.json` for Go Mode Android bootstrap. Clients must only accept `apiVersion` values they explicitly support and must require `webShell.bridgeVersion` to match the native bridge they implement.

Type notation: `JSONValue` means any valid JSON value.

## Settings

| Method | Path | Description | Request | Response |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| GET | `/.well-known/gomode.json` | Returns Go Mode service compatibility settings. |  | `Settings` |

## Errors

All errors return:

```json
{
  "error": { "code": "<CODE>", "message": "..." },
  "details": { ... }
}
```

| HTTP | Code |
|------|------|

## Types

### DisplayColorSpace

DisplayColorSpace is what a display's pixel values represent.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `luminance` | DisplayColorSpaceLuminance pixels are brightness levels that the device shows in its single tint, such as green on Even Realities G2. |
| `rgb` | DisplayColorSpaceRGB pixels are colours. Below 24 bits per pixel, the client picks the 2^BitsPerPixel colours of each image from 24-bit RGB. |

### DisplayShape

DisplayShape is the visible area of a display.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `circle` | DisplayShapeCircle shows the circle inscribed in the Width by Height pixels; pixels outside it are not visible. |
| `rectangle` | DisplayShapeRectangle shows every pixel. |

### ToolGroup

ToolGroup describes a bootstrap MCP tool group advertised by the manifest.

A tool group is the compatibility manifest's compact view of a Go Mode skill.
The authoritative context, activation hints, and tool subset live in the
skill's SKILL.md frontmatter; the manifest stays small so clients can decide
whether native features are compatible before loading skill files.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` |  | yes |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `endpoint` | `string` |  | yes |
| `protocolVersion` | `string` | ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version spoken by this group endpoint. The shell sends it on MCP requests so each group can be checked and upgraded independently during protocol migrations. | yes |
| `authRequired` | `boolean` |  | yes |
| `skillUrl` | `string` | SkillURL points to the SKILL.md file whose frontmatter defines activation, instructions, and the MCP tool subset for this skill. |  |

### Display

Display describes one connected display so a server can fit its content to
it. It is the settings object of the com.fghbuild.gomode/display client
capability extension, whose contract the Go constant DisplayExtension
documents. Servers must ignore fields they do not know.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `width` | `int` | Width is the number of pixel columns. It is positive. | yes |
| `height` | `int` | Height is the number of pixel rows. It is positive. | yes |
| `shape` | `DisplayShape` | Shape is the visible area within the Width by Height pixels. | yes |
| `colorSpace` | `DisplayColorSpace` | ColorSpace is what a pixel value represents. | yes |
| `bitsPerPixel` | `int` | BitsPerPixel is the pixel depth, from 1 to 24: a pixel shows one of 2^BitsPerPixel luminance levels or colours, as ColorSpace defines. | yes |
| `imageTypes` | `string[]` | ImageTypes lists the MIME types of the glasses image blocks the client draws on this display, such as "image/png". It is empty when the client draws glasses text alone, as on Even Realities G2. |  |

### ClientExtensions

ClientExtensions holds the settings objects of the Go Mode client capability
extensions, keyed as in ClientCapabilities.extensions. Clients encode it to
build that map, so generated SDKs carry each extension identifier.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `com.fghbuild.gomode/display` | `Display` | Display is present while glasses are connected. |  |

### ResourceDependency

ResourceDependency routes host change-feed events without interpreting domain
content. Each group contains at most 50 URIs. Empty aspects match any change.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `uris` | `string[] \| null` |  | yes |
| `aspects` | `string[]` |  |  |

### ConversationContext

ConversationContext orders one advertised model-context resource for one
authenticated conversation. URI identifies the resource this update replaces.
Only a read of that URI can establish
a new epoch. Dependencies are private event routing, never model content.
Content is the server-defined public resource text after a tool; resource reads
omit it because their standard contents already carry the same text.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `uri` | `string` |  | yes |
| `epoch` | `string` |  | yes |
| `version` | `int64` |  | yes |
| `dependencies` | `ResourceDependency[] \| null` |  | yes |
| `content` | `string` |  |  |

### ConversationResultMeta

ConversationResultMeta carries an authorized resource update after a tool.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `com.fghbuild.gomode/context` | `ConversationContext` |  |  |

### LocationWiFi

LocationWiFi matches any one of the configured Wi-Fi SSIDs.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `ssids` | `string[]` | SSIDs are Wi-Fi network names that can activate the skill. |  |

### PhysicalPosition

PhysicalPosition matches a named latitude and longitude within RadiusMeters.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` | Name is a user-facing label for this physical position. | yes |
| `latitude` | `float64` |  | yes |
| `longitude` | `float64` |  | yes |
| `radiusMeters` | `float64` | RadiusMeters is the activation radius around the latitude and longitude. | yes |

### LocationActivation

LocationActivation groups one location-based activation signal for a skill.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `wifi` | `LocationWiFi` |  |  |
| `physicalPosition` | `PhysicalPosition` |  |  |

### SkillActivation

SkillActivation carries hints the shell matches against current context to
decide when to load a skill. Matching is on-device: the service never receives
the user's context or location just because a skill was considered.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `locations` | `LocationActivation[]` | Locations are local physical-location and Wi-Fi hints that make this skill an activation candidate. |  |

| `authRequired` | `boolean` |  | yes |
| `tools` | `string[] \| null` | Tools is the explicit allowlist of MCP tool names activated by the skill. | yes |

### SkillFrontmatter

SkillFrontmatter is the YAML frontmatter schema for a Go Mode SKILL.md file.

The Markdown body carries human and model instructions. The frontmatter carries
machine-readable activation hints and the MCP tool allowlist that the native
shell can register when the skill becomes active.

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | `string` |  | yes |
| `description` | `string` |  | yes |
| `gomode` | `SkillGoMode` |  | yes |
